tasks.spec: B-1, R-3, AI-2, B-2, sprint costs control and touch, research 7.2 cross error and 7.3 (turn caps, first-touch trap error, shielding), no AI auto-tackles, yellow cards as events. (1) defend(): the first presser goes goal-side onto the carrier-goal line at jockey distance lerp(2.5,1.5,rt(DEF)), 80% pace inside 4 m, facing the ball (act 'jockey'); inside 22 m the second defender covers the shooting lane 3-5 m ahead; a beaten defender gets a recovery sprint. (2) tackles(): a standing tackle starts only when the ball is exposed (touch knocked it >0.6 m ahead or the carrier turns >60 degrees), after the read delay, with a visible 0.25 s wind-up (act 'poke'); success = tackleWin x angle (front 1.0, side 0.85, behind 0.6) x exposure; a miss stuns lerp(0.95,0.6,rt(DEF)); AI defenders never auto-tackle a dribbler who merely comes close. (4) Contact: running into a defender's body within 0.9 m in front costs pace x0.6-0.85 by PHY; shoulder duels by PHY; stick held back toward own goal with a defender within 1.5 m shields by PHY. (5) Lofted/cross error x1.2 at full sprint and x1.3 under pressure; first-touch trap error proportional to ball speed x (1-DRI) x1.3 sprinting x1.4 turning >90 degrees. tasks.title: Defend phases in solo matches
tasks.spec: S-1 defending. (1) engine.ts: Attack.human? 'A'|'D' and Attack.dctl? {id, stick, contain, slideDir?, queued?}; functions setDefStick, defContain, defTackle, defSlide, defSwitch, keeperRush; a humanDefender() branch in step. A defend phase is setupAttack(scenario, them, us, seed, {defIQ: OWN_DEF_IQ, human:'D'}) with the rival's autopilot at the soccer-5 ladder skill and iq. Contain (hold): backpedal at 80% pace facing the ball, goal-side at 1.5-2.5 m. Tackle (tap): soccer-4's standing tackle model. Slide (swipe on the pitch): 2.5 m along the swipe, wins by DEF and timing against an exposed ball; a miss means down 1.0 s with get-up; man before ball is a foul (penalty for them in the box). Switch (button or tap a player): defender nearest the ball's path by meetPoint, never one who can't reach a loose ball first; auto-switch modes off/cross-only (default)/on. Keeper RUSH button on a one-on-one; better smother odds timed at the carrier's touch. Teammate contain: AI defenders keep 3-4 m off and only tackle with the visible wind-up while you control the presser. A phase ends on a ball win, the attack's end, or 20 s of open play. (2) match.ts rival schedule: seven rival attacks dealt from 'ai:'+seed and resolved on the engine when reached. Soccer2 flow (solo only; online unchanged): your attack i then their attack i. Defend mode from prefs: 'key' (default: you defend counters, wide overloads and stoppage time; the rest auto-defended as a 4-6 s highlight with SKIP that fast-forwards the same deterministic sim), 'all', 'auto'; autoplayHook -> all auto. The rival's score and scorers come from these phases; Soccer2 reports onRival(progress). Points the next steps need:
- **Harness paths.** The audit harnesses import from /home/user/ps-studio by absolute path, so soccer-1 ports them into scripts/soccer/ first. Without that, measurements would test the wrong tree.
- **Env vars through the semaphore.** heavy.sh runs "$@", so an env var needs `bash O/heavy.sh env PS_SPORT=soccer npx vitest run soccer sport-branches`.
- **QA isolation.** scripts/qa/browser.mjs only restricts the base URL to localhost; it does not abort other hosts. soccer-1 adds the route-abort to both soccer QA scripts.
- **The shots-per-side target.** The brief's "12–13 shots per side" is met in two layers: played attacks get 9–13 shots per side at 9–14% conversion, and the full-time report fills unplayed minutes (seeded, display only) so the totals shown land at 8–18, mean 12–13.
- **Difficulty ladder (B-3).** It needs a `role` parameter on aiProgress, because Arcade.tsx and ut/Match.tsx call it with the same arguments for both sides. That costs a 1-line hunk in each shared file.
